name: Stability Ball Alternating Arm Raise
aliases: Swiss Ball Prone Alternating Arm Raise
steps: Rest your chest and abdomen on the stability ball with your toes spread apart on the floor behind you.
Let both arms hang toward the floor and look down to keep your neck aligned.
Raise one straight arm smoothly forward and upward beside your ear with your thumb pointing toward the ceiling, squeezing your upper back and rear shoulder.
Lower that arm slowly back down, then raise the opposite arm, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your chest settled calmly on the ball rather than jerking your lower back upward to lift your arm higher.
Keep your working shoulder down away from your ear as your arm rises.
